{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies package acceptance and eviction handling in `MemPoolAccept::AcceptPackage()` in `src/validation.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes incorrect rejection classifications for package transactions immediately evicted by mempool size limits. Returning `TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY` instead of `TX_RECONSIDERABLE` prevents valid evicted transactions from being reconsidered with higher-fee fee bumps."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label and includes functional test coverage for opportunistic 1p1c p2p package relay.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents package transactions from being improperly added to peer reject filters when trimmed by mempool limits immediately after acceptance. Without this fix, evicted parent transactions cannot be fetched or re-evaluated via p2p 1p1c until a new block arrives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/validation.cpp` solely within `MemPoolAccept`, which falls under mempool policy rather than consensus validation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The validation category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy, even when touching files in `src/validation.cpp`."
    }
